# Polymarket Gamma market nfl-dal-phi-2026-10-27-total-24pt5 (event nfl-dal-phi-2026-10-27, sportsMarketType=totals, restricted=True, captured 2026-09-19)

[description]
In the upcoming NFL game, scheduled for October 26 at 8:15 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if the Cowboys and Eagles combine to score 25 or more points in this game.

If the combined total is less than 25, this market will resolve to "Under".

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
